_note: menperfume (shopee/lazada/tokopedia/blibli ID) writes to the shared `cologne` dataset: cologne.cologne_dict / cologne.product_id_dict_qa / cologne.filter_cologne. cologne_dict columns are brand, sku_type_complete, user_category, keywords, keyword_typo, bundle_type, bundle_quantity -- there is NO _meta column on the dict table, and sku_type_complete is a BASE column (typed directly, brand-first: '<brand> <sub-brand/variant> <concentration> <size>'), not composed from sub_brand/variant/packsize columns like babycologne.

keywords.note: Corrected 2026-09-29: prior version omitted keyword_typo from sources even though it's documented as prepended below. keyword_typo is '' (never NULL) on the vast majority of rows, and the resulting leading space is literal (NOT trimmed) -- verified live: 7545/8606 rows (87.7%); most residual mismatches are legacy rows where keywords omits the brand token.

_sku_type_complete.size_format: '100 ml' (space before unit); multipack suffix ' x N pcs'; unknown variant -> 'Multi Variant'; unknown size -> 'Multi Size'

_attribute_vocab.bundle_quantity: FLOAT; 1.0 for single, N for multipack
